description.narrative: To generate learning from a range of programme ARs and PCRs on specific themes that can be shared across the FCDO programming community to help programme teams designing future ODA programmes use best practice and avoid common issues with programme delivery modalities. These learning documents will be held on the Solutions Hub FCDO intranet page (currently under development) for internal FCDO use and communicated in line with other Solutions Hub products. The research is focused on the “how” of programme delivery rather than the “what” - i.e., how specific delivery approaches supported (or didn’t support) achievement of programme objectives, or common challenges with making programme delivery mechanisms work rather than what mechanisms led to change. Synthesis products will, in the first instance, be focused on programme delivery modalities, including: a.Adaptive Programmes b.Programmes that have faced large ODA cuts in the last three years c.Centrally Managed Programmes If the products produced based on this first iteration of the work prove useful then it is possible that further synthesis products will be commissioned that are focused on other delivery modalities or on specific thematic areas (e.g. education, climate and environment) or on specific geographies (e.g. East Africa, Indo-Pacific). If required these will be outlined in subsequent ToRs.
